newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet prices dive on NYMEX, diff weakness.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet prices dive on NYMEX, diff weakness.

text.p: U.S. jet fuel prices fell sharply Thursday as both NYMEX prices and differentials weakened.
"That's good news for the end user," one trader for a major airlines said. NYMEX heating oil shed 1.55 cents by the settlement Thursday, finishing at 58.04 cents.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade barrels were talked between 0.75 and 1.00 cents over the screen for sixth cycle delivery on the Colonial Pipeline, down about 0.50 cent on the day.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade barrels changed hands at 4.25 cents, down 0.75 cent from Wednesday.
